description: Routes départementales - Département du Territoire de Belfort is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Creation of departmental roads (1813) It is the decree of December 16, 1811 that truly institutes what is customary to call the highway, placed under the authority of the Ministry of Public Works. Article 1 of that decree states that all roads in the Empire are divided into imperial roads and departmental roads. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Departmental roads - Department of the Territory of Belfort" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include routes départementales. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
